description: Sets Development's settings for one AI provider: rawCalls (true = the provider's own exact error text reaches the chat, for debugging — off by default), models (the allow-list a tool may pin or alias to; omit to leave it, [] to clear it to "any"), and — for provider compatible only — baseUrl and name (the endpoint's own address and label). Never a provider's key: that is provider_key's own door, never the chat. Live's settings stay a dashboard act, behind the founder's own step-up code — the same as a relay's pause.
name: set_ai_settings
title: Set an AI provider's settings
